literal: That which was thought all immediately he will attain, with the mind he will not think anger if.
translation: If a person does not let anger enter even his thoughts, he will instantly attain everything he has wished for.
modern: ஒருவன் தன் மனத்தால் கூடச் சினத்தை நினைக்கமாட்டான் என்றால், அவன் நினைத்ததை எல்லாம் உடனே அடைவான்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of absolute self-control over anger. If a person can prevent anger from even entering their mind, they achieve a state of mental clarity and strength. In this state, whatever they wish for or set their mind to will be attained immediately. The word 'உள்ளத்தால்' stresses that avoiding anger is not just an outward show, but a deep internal purity.
